instruction: pick up the black bowl from table center and place it on the plate
success_definition: LIBERO task goal; collision-free competition scoring is not applied
action_change_definition: Mean L2 norm of consecutive differences in the six normalized arm action channels; excludes gripper. Not physical jerk.

camera_fault.type: injected all-black image; camera restored after 2 simulated seconds

input_capture.pixels: actual post-fault-injection wrist RGB pixels, rotated 180 degrees exactly as policy._image()
input_capture.alignment: input step i is paired with external-camera frame i, before action i
input_capture.model_use: camera input recorded each control step; model uses the current image only at prediction_steps; guard consumes no model predictions while paused
